meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后,Mac 菜单栏会出现一个闪电图标,用绿点/红点显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行。点击图标可启动、停止或重启服务,也可查看日志。仅支持 macOS。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态指示器时触发。需要先确认系统是 macOS 且已安装 Xcode Command Line Tools。

howto.what_en: After installation, a bolt icon appears in the macOS menu bar with a green/red dot showing whether NanoClaw is running. Clicking it lets you start, stop, or restart the service and view logs. macOS only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. It first verifies macOS and Xcode Command Line Tools.
